metadata.description: Region for everything. Defaults to the resource group's.
The public addresses allowed to reach Argus, as IPv4 addresses or CIDR ranges (for example your office's). Nothing else reaches the site. A range that lets everyone in (/0 or /1) is refused.

Leave empty: the Connect line this deployment ends with makes the Argus sign-in app, and deploying again keeps the one the running site uses. Give a client ID only to use a sign-in app you registered yourself.
When the nightly collection runs, as HH:mm in UTC. 07:00 UTC is 2 AM US Eastern.
Keep the environment's console logs in a Log Analytics workspace (billed by the GB). Off: logs can still be streamed live.
The pull credential Higate gave you for Argus's image: its user name. Leave empty only for an image that needs no sign-in.
The pull credential's password. Give it on every deployment: Azure keeps it only in the container app's secrets, never in the deployment's history.
The Argus image, pinned to a release. Leave it as it is: it's the release's own image, by digest.

metadata.description: The next step: paste this one line into Azure Cloud Shell (PowerShell), signed in as an Entra admin of this tenant. It downloads Argus Connect for this release, stops unless its SHA-256 matches, then connects Argus to Microsoft 365.

nextStep.value: [format('& {{ $ErrorActionPreference = ''Stop''; $d = [IO.Directory]::CreateTempSubdirectory(''argus-connect-'').FullName; try {{ $z = Join-Path $d ''argus-connect.zip''; try {{ Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ''{0}'' -OutFile $z }} catch {{ Write-Host "Stopped: Argus Connect {1} couldn''t be downloaded ($($_.Exception.Message)). Nothing was run." -ForegroundColor Red; return }}; if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $z -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne ''{2}'') {{ Write-Host "Stopped: the download isn''t Argus Connect {3} (its SHA-256 doesn''t match). Nothing was run." -ForegroundColor Red; return }}; Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $z -DestinationPath (Join-Path $d ''connect''); & (Join-Path $d ''connect'' ''Connect-ArgusMicrosoft365.ps1'') -SubscriptionId ''{4}'' -ResourceGroupName ''{5}'' -AppName ''{6}'' @args }} finally {{ if ((Split-Path -Leaf $d) -like ''argus-connect-*'') {{ Remove-Item -LiteralPath $d -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }} }} }}', variables('connectUrl'), variables('connectVersion'), variables('connectSha256'), variables('connectVersion'), subscription().subscriptionId, resourceGroup().name, variables('appName'))]
